label: single host, synthetic deterministic fixtures, buffered I/O, FUSE over a real kernel; no device or power-loss claim; page caches not dropped

parameters.fuse_writeback: opt-in; buffer per handle, publish at flush/fsync/release
parameters.fuse_group_commit: opt-in; independent mutations coalesce within a 10 ms window, max 256 ops

durability.default: every mutation is a durably published commit before its reply
durability.write_back: buffered bytes are returned to the writing handle immediately; other readers and the store see them only after flush/fsync/release; fsync is durable before it replies; a crash loses unflushed writes
durability.group_commit: a group is durable only when published (window elapsed, 256 ops, fsync, or unmount); a crash leaves the previous whole generation
durability.crash_proxy_note: SIGKILL of the daemon is a process-fault proxy, not physical power loss and not a device-cache claim

conclusion: Mount identity defaults to merkle; write-back batches a handle's writes into one commit; group-commit coalesces independent mutations into one commit.
